children: Glucotrack completed a private placement, issuing $11.6 million in senior secured convertible notes to raise $4.5 million in cash and refinance $4.55 million of existing notes. The notes carry 8% interest, mature in nine months, and feature a floating conversion price with a floor, subject to Nasdaq exchange cap limits and potential reset upon stockholder approval. Investors also received five-year warrants for approximately 4.83 million shares at a $7.50 exercise price. Dawson James acted as placement agent, earning a 7% cash fee, expense reimbursement, and five-year placement agent warrants.
